title: Transport principal divisors through a K-algebra isomorphism
statement: Let K, E and L be fields, with K-algebra structures on E and L. If e : E ≃ₐ[K] L is a K-algebra isomorphism and AlgebraicCurve.HasPrincipalDivisors K E holds, then AlgebraicCurve.HasPrincipalDivisors K L holds. No characteristic, finite-dimensionality, or residue-field finiteness assumption is required.
lean_statement: ∀ (K E L : Type*) [Field K] [Field E] [Field L] [Algebra K E] [Algebra K L], (E ≃ₐ[K] L) → AlgebraicCurve.HasPrincipalDivisors K E → AlgebraicCurve.HasPrincipalDivisors K L
